n: 24 In. Monument Series 3rd Rack Dishwasher With Auto Door Open Drying, 44dba, Satin Stainless Steel Panel
desc: The ZLINE 24 in. Monument Series 3rd Rack Dishwasher with Auto Door Open Drying, 44dBa, Satin Stainless Steel Panel (DWMT-SN-24) pairs a powerful heated dry cycle with advanced Auto Door Open technology, ensuring efficient drying for plastics and complex dishware. Engineered to eliminate common kitchen frustrations through smarter performance, this next-generation model features specialized high-pressure bottle wash jets, a discreet floor timer display, and a sophisticated aesthetic purposefully designed to be the centerpiece of any custom luxury kitchen.
hl: Efficiently dry coffee mugs and deep-bottom items with a door that automatically opens at the end of the cycle to release steam and circulate fresh air
Wash reusable water bottles, carafes, and narrow glassware with specialized high-pressure jets designed to thoroughly clean hard-to-access areas
Organize flatware and silverware on a slim third rack with a versatile sliding design that can be retracted to make room for taller glasses below
A soft blue LED timer projects the remaining wash time onto your floor, bringing visibility to concealed controls so you always know when dishes are ready
A built-in UV LED light reduces the buildup of moisture-related impurities, minimizes odors, and supports a cleaner interior environment between cycles
A professional Heated Dry Mode utilizes high-grade heating elements for more effective drying that leaves dishes spotless
spec: Energy Star, CEC, UL, NSF Certified
